title: Facade – Water Testing (PER)
activity: Hose and spray-bar water testing of the facade (witness point)
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Test location is one of the agreed locations (marked on the drawing/elevation)?
Everything in the test area complete – seals tooled, membranes lapped, sills and closures fitted?
Observer inside with a torch, internal finishes protected or not yet installed?
Ask the fitter: Which locations were agreed for testing, and what's the pass criteria? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Water run at the joints, frame perimeters, sill ends and sliding door thresholds/corners?
No water inside – check the sill, frame corners, threshold, membrane laps and the slab edge?
Any leak marked, photographed and logged in Field before the area is closed up?
Failed location repaired and re-tested – and passed – before internal finishes go on?

notOk.t: Water ingress inside after the test (sill, corners, threshold)
Failed areas closed up before a re-test
Waterproofing failed / membrane gaps at upstands

ask.q: What test standard and pressure are you using?
ask.a: As the approved Permasteelisa test procedure – hose at the set distance/time per joint.

ask.q: What length are you testing and who witnesses?
ask.a: The agreed sample length, witnessed by MPX, recorded with photos.
Fail recorded, fix, retest the same area.
